notes: Inline text link. Label renders through Text atom for typography. For links that need visual weight (glass, pill, padding), use Button with href instead. Pipeline strips animation props in reduced/textonly. Textonly: all variants degrade to plain underlined text. Click + keyboard handling is native <a href> + global focus-system. Colour comes from the global .color--{name} mixin (colour.css).

contentLink.description: Link content. Either a string (whole phrase is the link) OR an array of segments. Each segment is { "nolink": "plain text" } or { "link": "clickable word" }. Each link segment renders as its own <a href> sharing this Link's href. Plain text segments render as <span>. All segments share the same textStyle.

items._description: Segment must have exactly one of nolink or link.

link._description: Clickable text segment — wrapped in <a href> with link styling.

external.description: External link — adds target=_blank and rel=noopener noreferrer.

confetti.description: Fire particle burst on click. Wires into particle-burst.ts — link navigation is delayed 400ms so the burst is visible. Respects motion-gate.

text._description: Text atom styling props forwarded to Link's nested Text atom. Link controls content (via contentLink) and 'as' (always span) internally.

textStyle._description: Partial spread of Text styling props. Each key validates against Text's enum.

colour._description: Brand-scale colour. Use one of brandColor or rainbowColor, never both.

brandColor.description: Brand-scale colour. Default 'text' = body text colour (link blends into prose, hover shifts to primary). Set 'primary'/'secondary'/'neutral' for a louder coloured link.

rainbow._description: Rainbow palette colour (1-7 positional). Use one of brandColor or rainbowColor.

variant.description: Visual indicator style. default=semibold + thin underline (conventional link), bare=colour only with hover shift (quiet inline), underline=loud thicker underline, highlight=subtle background, border=thin border, ghost=sunken pill, frame=four corner brackets reveal on hover.

disabled.description: Disabled state — strikethrough, not-allowed cursor, no hover/click/focus, no highlight-links outline. Sets aria-disabled=true and tabindex=-1.

animation._description: Motion behaviour — stripped in reduced/textonly renders

underlineGrow.description: Underline scales from left on hover. Requires variant=underline for static fallback.

highlightGrow.description: Background highlight grows from bar to full coverage on hover. Requires variant=highlight for static fallback.

shadowFill.description: Box-shadow inset fills from left on hover. Works with any variant.

textSlide.description: Text colour sweeps from left via background-clip, with coordinated underline grow.

squiggle.description: Animate the variant=underline wavy line so it slides on hover. Only meaningful with variant=underline.
